subtitle: Ads
introEn: Read the passage and choose the best answer.

items.passage: Questions 1-2 refer to the following advertisement. Call for Volunteers We are looking for volunteers in the Capitol Hill area to work with your neighbors, business owners, and city employees on Saturday, August 23, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. to help clean up graffiti. All materials and instruction are provided. Come for a few hours or all day. As a volunteer you will: * Receive a free T-shirt * Receive a great breakfast and lunch, provided by local restaurants * Meet new friends * Do something good for our community. So come join the fun! Contact Ann at 206-329-6781.
